title: Ovid2 transform spec
description: A named, reusable chain of general-purpose transform ops from the public transformations library. Free-standing (not bound to a CDM table). Loaded from resources/transforms/<name>.yaml (shared) or pipelines/<pipeline>/transforms/<name>.yaml (per-pipeline).

v.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

name.description: Optional spec identifier (defaults to the file stem).

description.description: Human/agent-readable summary of what the chain does.

enabled.description: When false, the chain is a no-op.

steps.description: Ordered list of transform ops. Applied in order.

op.description: Op name — must be registered in ovid2.transforms.registry.TRANSFORMS.
